CUISINE.intro: Assamese cuisine is defined by two notes — khar (alkaline) and tenga (sour). Rice is the centre and the meal is finished with a slice of kaji nemu. Little oil, bold herbs and the smoke of bamboo shoot give it a character entirely its own.

dishes.name: Khar
dishes.about: Raw papaya and pulses cooked with filtered plantain-ash water — the signature first course of every Assamese meal.

dishes.name: Masor Tenga
dishes.about: Rohu or catfish in a light, tangy broth of ou tenga (elephant apple) or tomato.

dishes.name: Kharoli
dishes.about: Toasted mustard flour whipped with khar water into a smoky, pungent dip for rice.

dishes.name: Duck with Bamboo Shoot
dishes.about: Slow-cooked duck with tender bamboo shoot and ash gourd — an Ahom kitchen heirloom.

dishes.name: Pitha
dishes.about: Til (sesame), narikol (coconut) and ghila pitha — the sweets of Magh Bihu and every welcome.

dishes.name: Assam Tea
dishes.about: Strong, malty and golden — from the Brahmaputra's floodplains that grow over half of India's tea.

ADVENTURE.name: Brahmaputra Rafting
ADVENTURE.about: River-running and kayaking across Asia's great river, with picnic beaches on its sandbars (chars).

ADVENTURE.name: Barail & Karbi Treks
ADVENTURE.about: Misty hill trails of the Barail range and the Langhovku waterfalls above Diphu.

ADVENTURE.name: Tea-Garden Cycling
ADVENTURE.about: Cycle the flat green rows of the world's largest tea-growing region at first-flush dawn.

ADVENTURE.name: Rhino Safari
ADVENTURE.about: Elephant-back and jeep safaris through elephant grass to meet the great one-horned rhino.

WELLNESS.name: Sattra Meditation
WELLNESS.about: Sit in the naamghar at dawn as Borgeet rises — a centuries-old contemplative practice.

WELLNESS.name: River-Island Calm
WELLNESS.about: Yoga on the Mising stilt-houses of Asia's largest river island, cradled by the Brahmaputra.

WELLNESS.name: Tea-Garden Wellness
WELLNESS.about: Ayurvedic and herbal retreats among the gardens, with the first flush on your table.

headline: The Living Soul of
the Red River.
CULTURE_HERO.sub: Six centuries of Ahoms, the sattras of Majuli, muga silk and the one-horned rhino — the culture of Assam, told through its people, places and festivals.

headline: Discover the Wild Soul of Assam
HERO_SLIDES.sub: From the majestic one-horned rhinoceros to vibrant birdlife, explore the extraordinary wildlife that makes Assam a sanctuary of nature.

headline: Where Nature Paints Its Masterpiece
HERO_SLIDES.sub: Journey through endless tea gardens, misty hills, mighty rivers and breathtaking landscapes that capture the untouched beauty of Assam.

headline: A Legacy Woven Through Time
HERO_SLIDES.sub: Explore the timeless traditions, ancient kingdoms, vibrant communities and cultural treasures that tell the unforgettable story of Assam.
